Yuushi no Monshou - Deep Dungeon.name: Yuushi no Monshou: Deep Dungeon
Yuushi no Monshou - Deep Dungeon.summary: Hundreds of years have passed, the spirit of the long forgotten evil Emperor Ruu has returned. A hero claiming to be the descendant of the previous hero Raru appears in the town of Dorl, and sets on exploring a tower in order to defeat Ruu.
